significance: A south-facing Shiva temple with a seven-tiered rajagopuram on the western edge of Chennai, counted among the city's Navagraha temples. The Carnatic composer Tyagaraja composed the five songs of the Kovur Pancharatnam here.
story: The place is said to take its name from Mahalakshmi, who came to the spot in the form of a cow to worship Shiva.
